page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword "Sæpe" at the lower right.

main_text.p: ge Iuramento Fidelitatis & Christianæ Re-ligionis fundamentis contra cunctis mili-tantibus (quibus intùs jam agitantur, & fe in corde fuo accufant) quâ olim actì vecordiâ, in quas Deus mihi dederat copias impetum fecerunt.

Horum fors utcunque ærumnofa, op-prefsis plærifque aut extinctis, (haud dubito) longè optabilior est pio homi-ni, & mentis bene fanæ (cui officium fuum & falus Animæ præfentaneæ hu-jus vitæ oblectamentis potiora) quam omnes Hoftium noftrorum Triumphi & Gloria, qui vix fieri poteft ut effu-giant quotidianos illos horrores, qui-bus (femper ambiguæ, nunc vero pa-lam convictæ) confcientiæ Illos per-fequuntur, præfertim poftquam Orbi jam factis conftet, quàm falfi penitùs & ab animis Ipforum alienifimi illi pri-mò fparfi Prætextus fuere, quibus for-fan fpeciofum aliquid inerat, nil, quod juftè excufaret vel hæc ἔργα[?] moveri, velin illis tam diù perftari, contra Me & Leges fancitas, in quorum utriufque confervatione omnes probi arbitrantur publicam maximè falutem confiftere atque adeo propter fimul & cum illis hone-ftius multo & fœlicius ducunt occum-bere, quam per Ruinas has crefcere & ex-tolli.

page.notes: A small reference mark (a circle or sign) stands before "confervatione" in the text, with no matching note on the page. The Greek word "ἔργα" after "hæc" is uncertain and marked [?]. Italic type is approximate in places. The first word is a fragment that continues from the previous page. Printed spelling kept, e.g. "falus", "prefsis", "Orbi".
